products.name: You.com Enterprise
products.note: Private search AI; no tracking; enterprise deployment; data privacy focus

reading.body:
You.com offers search-augmented LLMs to both consumers and enterprises, positioning itself as an alternative to general-purpose AI assistants by integrating real-time web search with language models.

The company's dual product strategy reflects a division between consumer and enterprise markets. The consumer product pairs search results with LLM responses, addressing a core limitation of language models: their training data has a knowledge cutoff. The enterprise product emphasizes privacy and closed deployment, suggesting demand exists among organizations unwilling to route queries through public APIs. Both products target the integration layer between retrieval and generation, a capability increasingly central to AI applications that must ground responses in current information.

For compute and infrastructure requirements, search-augmented systems impose distinct constraints compared to standalone language models. Real-time search requires maintaining low-latency connections to indexing infrastructure and query infrastructure, adding operational complexity beyond model inference. The enterprise product's focus on private deployment and no tracking indicates customers value data residency and control, which may drive higher infrastructure costs relative to shared cloud services.

The data does not specify You.com's scale of deployment, number of users, computational requirements, or power consumption. It does not cover whether the company operates its own search infrastructure or relies on third-party APIs, a distinction material to understanding its actual compute footprint. The California legal exposure count is noted but without case details, providing limited insight into regulatory or operational risk.

profile_text.body:
You.com is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as providing leading web search APIs for AI, with its site emphasizing web search, clean content extraction, and grounded answer generation for agents and large language models, with a stated focus on accuracy, freshness, and latency.

The company offers two tracked products. The first is You.com, a search-augmented large language model available to general users. The second is You.com Enterprise, a private search AI product aimed at business deployment, with a focus on data privacy and no user tracking.

The held facts indicate You.com has a notable legal footprint, with 175 cases recorded under California exposure, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
